text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Mejiro Bright's debut race. She 
brought her stuffed doll to the venue, 
totally marching to the beat of her own 
drum as always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her heart was deadly serious. 
They realized she had been making a 
conscious effort to stay calm by 
deliberately acting as she always did.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"At my own pace." Murmuring those words to 
herself, she headed toward the race.
